descriptions.startup: Engine running, stationary, RPM still climbing from cold-start idle (rolling RPM slope above the flatten threshold). Ends once RPM stabilizes, not on a fixed timer. Window for cold-cylinder/sticky-valve check: RPM rise should correlate with EGT/CHT rise per cylinder within this window.
descriptions.warmup: Engine running, no GPS movement, oil warming.
descriptions.taxi_out: Low RPM, GPS position creeping toward runway/runup area.
descriptions.runup: RPM ~1600-2100, no GPS movement, mag check.
descriptions.takeoff: Max power (RPM >= 2400, MP >= 25"), GPS position creeping or airborne, AGL < 200ft.
descriptions.climb: Airborne (AGL >= 200ft), sustained positive altitude rate (> 350 fpm).
descriptions.cruise: Airborne, level flight (altitude rate within +-350 fpm).
descriptions.descent: Airborne, sustained altitude loss (< -350 fpm), not yet near the field.
descriptions.approach: Airborne, AGL < 300ft near the field, speed < 90kts, speed >= 30kts.
descriptions.landing: AGL < 300ft near the field, speed < 30kts, decelerating.
descriptions.taxi_in: Post-landing, low RPM, GPS position creeping.
